notes: «قال سمعت البراء» makes Bara' a link (rule 5); «قال أبو بكر مررنا براع» has Abu Bakr speaking the report in the story, so he is added as the last link under rule 6 (the speaker is the last link); needs_ruling because it is not settled whether Bara' or Abu Bakr is the report's final transmitter; «سراقة بن جعشم» is the subject of the story and not a link; «قدم النبي» names the Prophet, who is not a link
